sourceChecks.text: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
sourceChecks.previousContext: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.
sourceChecks.nextContext: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

sourceChecks.text: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
sourceChecks.previousContext: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
sourceChecks.nextContext: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

sourceChecks.text: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,
sourceChecks.previousContext: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
sourceChecks.nextContext: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

sourceChecks.text: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
sourceChecks.previousContext: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.
sourceChecks.nextContext: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
